assignment: Write a registration policy memo balancing graduation needs and transparent access.
source: A lab course has 30 seats, 25 continuing enrollments and 14 applicants for the remaining seats. Six applicants need it to graduate this term. Existing first-come registration favors users available online at noon. The lab cannot exceed 30 seats. A second section would need instructor approval by Friday.

criteria.full: Identifies five openings and at least one unmet graduation need even if all openings prioritize that group.
criteria.partial: Recognizes scarcity without reconciling seats and graduation needs.

criteria.full: Defines a transparent eligibility check and fair tie breaker within priority groups without exceeding capacity.
criteria.partial: Uses a priority slogan without resolving a tie among six.

criteria.full: Develops a conditional second-section or approved substitute path and an actionable Friday deadline.
criteria.partial: Assumes a second section is available without approval.

criteria.full: Specifies notice, an appeal or correction window and a measurable access outcome.
criteria.partial: Mentions communicating the result without explaining correction or evaluation.
